candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Apply Buckingham Pi to the dependent dimensionless quantity nu_t/nu and the four dimensional inputs u_tau, h, y, nu. Dimensions: u_tau [L T^-1], h [L], y [L], nu [L^2 T^-1]. Number of fundamental dimensions r = 3 (M,L,T). Number of variables including the dependent one n = 5, so number of independent dimensionless Pi groups = n - r = 2. Two convenient independent dimensionless groups are Pi1 = y/h and Pi2 = u_tau * y / nu. Therefore the normalized eddy viscosity must be a function of these two groups: nu_t/nu = F(y/h, u_tau * y / nu).
